question: is there a defined frozen production control for carry -> rushing yards
method: read from the repository; nothing inferred from the existence of code

1_canonical_research_module.estimand: predictive distribution of player-game rushing yards, built as a compound: draw the carry count from the accepted P4C joint allocation, then draw that many per-carry outcomes
1_canonical_research_module.finding_document_note: rc1, rc2 and td1 each carry a *_FINDING.md. P5A has none. There is no written adjudication of its own predeclared selection rule.

3_owner_action.contrast: receiving_conversion carries decision RC1-ACCEPT-001 and decision_artifact nfl/NFL_RC1_ACCEPTANCE_DECISION.json. rushing_conversion carries neither.

4_historical_inputs.carry_table: per-carry yardage extracted from pbp, 2016 onward (pbp availability), reconciled against the panel
4_historical_inputs.opportunity: P4C joint allocation (carries class) x team volume

5_frozen_parameters.note: these are computed quantities from the 2025 evaluation fold, not a frozen production parameter set. No file in this repository names the parameters a production rushing-conversion control would use.

6_uncertainty_representation.form: compound sum of per-carry draws; non-positive, ordinary and explosive runs stay distinguishable by construction
6_uncertainty_representation.negative_outcomes: PERMITTED -- the pooled per-carry distribution contains stuffs and losses; p_stuff is 0.2018

7_player_history_shrinkage.form: empirical-Bayes shrinkage of player yards-per-carry, explosive rate and stuff rate toward the pooled prior
7_player_history_shrinkage.appears_in: system B and above only; the control A carries no player-specific efficiency information of any kind

8_position_team_fallback.predeclared: control A stratifies the pooled distribution by position group, RB versus non-RB rusher (predeclaration section 5)
8_position_team_fallback.implemented: p5a_lib.Pool is built from ALL prior-season carries with no position stratification
8_position_team_fallback.status: DISCREPANCY -- the implemented control is not the predeclared control

9_chronology_rule.predeclared: strict walk-forward; every parameter fitted on seasons < Y; within-season histories from games strictly before the target game; carry history may reach back to 2016
9_chronology_rule.family_selection_defect: predeclaration section 9 requires the family to be chosen by CRPS on an INNER VALIDATION SEASON (Y-1) fitted on seasons before that. run_p5a.py instead scores each family against the EVALUATION season's own realised rushing yards (run_p5a.py: sc = L.score(Y, y, ...) where y is the eval-season truth) and keeps the minimum. No inner-validation code exists anywhere in nfl/research/p5a/.

10_known_limitations: every reported P5A CRPS is a best-of-four minimum taken on the test season, so the figures are optimistic by an unmeasured amount
the four evaluation seasons are heavily mined development data and the artifacts label themselves EXPLORATORY
the oracle arms (O_carries CRPS ~5.0 against a control ~10.2) show most of the recoverable signal is in the CARRY COUNT, not in conversion

criteria: 2. the team-game block-bootstrap interval on the CRPS difference excludes zero
3. the direction is consistent in at least 3 of the 4 evaluation seasons
4. randomised PIT does not worsen by more than 25% relative
5. tail calibration -- forecast minus observed P(20+ yard rush) -- does not worsen in absolute value

missing_scientific_decisions.question: Which distributional family does the control use for a season with no outcomes?
missing_scientific_decisions.why_it_blocks: The family is currently selected by CRPS against the evaluation season's own realised yards. That rule cannot run for 2026, and adopting "the family 2025 chose" imports a choice made from 2025 outcomes. The predeclared inner-validation nesting (Y-1) was never implemented.
missing_scientific_decisions.what_would_resolve_it: implement the predeclared inner-validation selection and re-run P5A, or record a decision fixing one family for production

missing_scientific_decisions.question: Is promotion criterion 4 evaluated per season or pooled?
missing_scientific_decisions.why_it_blocks: It is the only criterion B breaches, and it breaches in one season of four. Read per season, no rung is promoted and the control is A. Read pooled, B (and plausibly E) may clear the bar and the control is a player-shrunk system. The predeclaration does not say, and criterion 3 is the only one that names a per-season rule.
missing_scientific_decisions.what_would_resolve_it: an owner reading of section 14, recorded as a decision artifact

missing_scientific_decisions.question: Is the production control the predeclared position-stratified pool, or the unstratified pool that was implemented?
missing_scientific_decisions.why_it_blocks: These are different distributions. QB and WR carries sit in the same pool as RB carries in the implementation.
missing_scientific_decisions.what_would_resolve_it: a correction to P5A or a decision adopting the implemented form

what_this_packet_did_instead: Implemented the rushing-conversion INTERFACE as a named refusal carrying these three decisions, and the structural prohibitions section C asks for (no point yards-per-carry, no caller-supplied efficiency prior). No control was invented.
what_is_NOT_blocked: the rushing TOUCHDOWN control is separate and is defined -- see the R4 return section D.
